arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && md5sum scratch/stock.json scratch/reserved.json && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
stock=json.load(open('scratch/stock.json',encoding='utf-8'))
res=json.load(open('scratch/reserved.json',encoding='utf-8'))
out=[{"sku":k,"available":stock[k]-res.get(k,0)} for k in sorted(stock)]
with open('scratch/available.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
EOF
cat scratch/available.json && md5sum scratch/stock.json scratch/reserved.json
